analyst.text: De'Aaron Fox (shin) is questionable for a return to Sacramento, Victor Wembanyama is questionable with back tightness, and Dylan Harper is out. The Kings just ended an eight-game skid by beating Boston, but coach Doug Christie is in a lame-duck year and Domantas Sabonis was reported earlier this month to want out. Spurs absences could tighten it, but the angle still leans San Antonio.
